name: myCred Toolkit – Ultimate Addons for WordPress Gamification & Loyalty
author: myCred

sections.description:
myCred Toolkit is an all-in-one package designed to enhance user engagement through gamification. With 30+ free add-ons, myCred Toolkit seamlessly integrates with leading WordPress plugins for WooCommerce reward points, allowing you to reward users, automate engagement, and elevate your website experience—all in one place.

🔥 Why Choose myCred Toolkit?

  • Comprehensive Gamification Tools – Implement WooCommerce reward points, badges, leaderboards, and WooCommerce points and rewards with ease.
  • Seamless Third-Party Integrations – Compatible with BuddyPress, LearnDash, Elementor, Zapier, and more.
  • Engagement-Boosting Features – It can be used as a woocommerce reward points plugin to encourage participation through interactive incentives.
  • Effortless Setup & Management – Access all free and ultimate add-ons of myCred in a single, user-friendly package.

Powerful Add-ons Included in myCred Toolkit

🛒 Gamification & WooCommerce Points and Rewards

  • Badgr Integration – Sync myCred achievements with Badgr’s digital badging system.
  • BP Group Leaderboards – Automatically generate leaderboards based on user point balances.
  • BuddyPress Compliments – Reward users for giving and receiving compliments.
  • myCred Birthdays – Assign points to users on their birthdays to enhance engagement, similar to any WordPress loyalty plugin.
  • myCred Credly – Synchronize myCred badges with Credly to boost credibility; especially for a WooCommerce loyalty program.

🖥 eLearning Integrations

  • myCred LearnDash – Award points for course completions, lessons, quizzes, and more.
  • myCred LifterLMS – A WordPress rewards plugin that rewards or deducts points based on student performance.
  • myCred Tutor LMS – Enhance Tutor LMS with point-based rewards for learning achievements.
  • myCred Courseware – Easily integrate gamification into your online courses.
  • myCred LearnDash Points Importer – Seamlessly sync LearnDash points with myCred balances.

🙌 Community & User Engagement

  • myCred BuddyBoss Integration – Reward interactions like follows, friendships, and messages.
  • myCred AnsPress – Encourage community discussions with points for Q&A participation.
  • myCred WP-PostViews – Award content creators based on the number of post views.
  • myCred TotalPoll & TotalSurvey – Incentivize participation in polls and surveys Membership rewards plugin WordPress.

📜 Events & Memberships

  • myCred Event Espresso & Event Manager Pro – Reward users for event registrations and attendance.
  • myCred MemberPress – Introduce gamification to memberships and subscriptions.
  • myCred Paid Membership Pro – Grant or deduct points based on membership actions.
  • myCred GiveWP – Reward donations with points and badges.

💳 Automation & Payment Integrations

  • myCred Zapier – Automate workflows by connecting with thousands of web apps.
  • myCred Square – Enable users to purchase points through the Square payment gateway.
  • myCred WP Simple Pay – Award points for payments processed via WP Simple Pay.
  • myCred Zoom – This WooCommerce points and rewards addon incentivize users for attending Zoom meetings.

🔑 Migration & Custom Integrations

  • myCred GamiPress Importer – Migrate GamiPress data into myCred effortlessly.
  • myCred Retro – Retroactively assign points for past activities.
  • myCred Elementor – Convert myCred shortcodes into drag-and-drop Elementor widgets.
  • myCred Rating Form & GD Rating – Reward users for rating content and contributing reviews.

🛠 Who Needs myCred Toolkit?

myCred Toolkit helps gamifiy the following industries:
⭐ E-learning Platforms – Reward learners for course completions, quizzes, and participation.
⭐ Community Websites – Boost engagement through leaderboards, compliments, and badges.
⭐ Membership and WooCommerce Points and Rewards Sites – Incentivize user interactions and subscriptions with points and rewards.
⭐ Event Management Platforms – Encourage participation in events with point-based WooCommerce reward points.
⭐ E-commerce Stores – Enhance customer loyalty with gamified incentives and WooCommerce points and rewards.
⭐ Developers & Agencies – Streamline gamification features for client websites with a single, powerful toolkit.

💨 Get Started with myCred Toolkit

myCred Toolkit is designed for WordPress site owners who want to boost engagement, increase user retention, and integrate WooCommerce reward points plugin seamlessly. Whether you’re running an e-learning platform, a membership site, or an online community, myCred Toolkit provides ultimate addons that you need to create an engaging, rewarding experience for your WordPress loyalty plugin users.

Download myCred Toolkit today and transform your website into a dynamic, interactive experience.
